name: io.github.peguesj/whmcs-mcp
description: MCP server for the WHMCS External API: read-only by default, write actions opt-in per domain, confirmation-gated billing/destructive mutations, PII/secret redaction, and runtime version detection (verified against the 8.12.x and 9.0.x contract).

environmentVariables.name: WHMCS_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the WHMCS install, e.g. https://billing.example.com (the client POSTs to {WHMCS_API_URL}/includes/api.php). HTTPS required unless WHMCS_MCP_ALLOW_INSECURE=1.

environmentVariables.name: WHMCS_API_IDENTIFIER
environmentVariables.description: API Credentials identifier created in WHMCS (Setup > Staff Management > API Credentials), scoped to a least-privilege API Role.

environmentVariables.name: WHMCS_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: API Credentials secret paired with WHMCS_API_IDENTIFIER. Never logged; redacted from all tool output and error messages.

environmentVariables.name: WHMCS_API_ACCESS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional $api_access_key value, used instead of / in addition to IP allowlisting on the WHMCS side.

environmentVariables.name: WHMCS_MCP_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Advertised tool tiers: readonly (default; read tools only), write (adds write + destructive-with-confirm tools), full (also adds the billing tier and whmcs_raw_call). Invoice-mutating tools stay behind full regardless of this value's other effects.

environmentVariables.name: WHMCS_MCP_ENABLE_DOMAINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowlist of tool domains to advertise (system,tickets,clients,products,invoices,domains,orders). Omit to advertise all domains permitted by WHMCS_MCP_MODE.

environmentVariables.name: WHMCS_MCP_REDACT_PII
environmentVariables.description: 1 (default) redacts client PII (email, phone, address) from tool output in addition to secrets/payment data; 0 disables PII redaction (secrets and payment data are always redacted).

environmentVariables.name: WHMCS_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for calls to the WHMCS External API.

environmentVariables.name: WHMCS_MCP_RATE_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Token-bucket requests-per-minute cap enforced by the client against the WHMCS External API.

environmentVariables.name: WHMCS_MCP_ALLOW_INSECURE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 only for local/dev testing against a non-HTTPS WHMCS_API_URL. Never set in a production deployment.

remotes.description: Optional local Streamable HTTP transport, started with `whmcs-mcp --http` and bound to 127.0.0.1 only. Uses the same environment variables as the stdio package above; not published as a hosted remote.
